capital.evidence_quote: Kathmandu is the capital and largest metropolis of the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal

currency.evidence_quote: The Nepalese Rupee (NPR) is the official currency of Nepal, pegged to the Indian Rupee

timezone.evidence_quote: Nepal observes Nepal Standard Time UTC+5:45 year-round based on Mount Gauri Sankar

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard domestic electrical supply in Nepal is 230V alternating current at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid alternating frequency is maintained at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Nepal utilizes Europlug Type C and round-pin Indian Type D and Type M plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 100 for emergency police assistance throughout Nepal

sources.title: Ministry of Health and Population of Nepal

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 102 for emergency medical response and Red Cross ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 101 for municipal fire brigade dispatch in Nepal

general.evidence_quote: 100 acts as the national primary emergency dispatch center

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police specialized toll-free hotline 1144 provides 24/7 trekking rescue and assistance

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Nepal genelinde güvenlik ortamı huzurludur; yüksek irtifa dağcılığı ve muson dönemi heyelanlarına dikkat edilmelidir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise normal precautions; prepare adequately for high-altitude sickness (AMS) on Himalayan treks.
advisory_headline.de: In Nepal gelten normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen; Höhenkrankheit (AMS) bei Trekkingtouren beachten.
advisory_headline.ru: В Непале действует нормальный уровень безопасности; соблюдайте правила акклиматизации в Гималаях.
advisory_headline.es: Aplican precauciones normales de viaje; tome precauciones contra el mal de altura en los Himalayas.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Nepal measure 22.8 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Nepal reach 56.4 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Ncell and Nepal Telecom (Namaste) offer tourist SIM and eSIM cards at Tribhuvan International Airport; bring passport photos. Mandatory TIMS card and licensed guide required for mountain trekking.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Solo trekking regulations require a licensed trekking guide and TIMS registration permit

tr.conditions: Türk vatandaşları Katmandu Tribhuvan Havalimanı'nda Kapıda Vize (VoA) alabilir (15 gün 30$, 30 gün 50$, 90 gün 125$).

us.conditions: US citizens can obtain a Visa on Arrival at Tribhuvan Airport (15/30/90 days) or apply online beforehand.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens receive Visa on Arrival at Kathmandu airport (15/30/90 days with valid passport).

gb.conditions: British passport holders are eligible for Visa on Arrival at Tribhuvan Airport for 15, 30, or 90 days.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ получают визу по прибытии в аэропорту Катманду на срок 15, 30 или 90 дней.

dos.title: Always walk clockwise around stupas and mani stones
dos.description: In Buddhist and Hindu tradition, always circumambulate chortens, stupas (Boudhanath), and prayer wheels clockwise.

dos.title: Greet with 'Namaste' with hands together
dos.description: Place palms together at chest level and bow slightly; it conveys deep spiritual respect.

dos.title: Obtain helicopter evacuation insurance for trekking
dos.description: Always secure travel insurance that covers emergency high-altitude helicopter rescue up to 6,000 meters.

donts.title: Don't touch anyone's head or point your feet
donts.description: The head is sacred and feet are considered unclean; never stretch feet towards shrines, monks, or elders.

donts.title: Don't trek without a licensed guide
donts.description: Nepalese regulations mandate hiring a licensed guide for mountain trekking to prevent solo accidents.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in tourist restaurants; tipping trekking guides and porters at the end of a mountain expedition is customary and expected.
